7 انقعث It was, or became, pulled out, or up, (As, S, O, TA,) from the foundation, or utterly; (As, S, TA;) it was, or became, eradicated, or uprooted. (K.) One says, ضَرَبَهُ فَٱنْقَعَثَ He struck it, and it became pulled out, or up, (As, S, O, TA,) from the foundation, or utterly. (As, S, TA.) ―
-b2- And It (a wall) fell down from its foundation: like انقعف. (As, S, O.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
